objective: Chọn unit phù hợp với scale/context của một stated measurement và dùng order-of-magnitude estimation để kiểm tra plausibility của numerical value hoặc unit conversion mà không nhầm estimate với exact result hay physical accuracy.

external_curriculum_mappings.phase: KS1-KS3 measurement, estimation and unit choice

misconceptions_or_representation_notes: A familiar unit is not automatically appropriate for every scale.
An estimate can expose an implausible conversion but does not establish instrument accuracy.

objective: Compose/decompose common 2-D shapes and relate simple 3-D solids to nets plus top/front/side 2-D views, recognizing that a representation depends on arrangement or viewing direction.

external_curriculum_mappings.phase: KS1-KS3 compose/decompose shapes, 3-D forms and nets

misconceptions_or_representation_notes: The same region can have more than one valid decomposition.
A single 2-D view may correspond to multiple 3-D solids.
A net and an orthographic-like view encode different information.

objective: Dùng horizontal/vertical/parallel/perpendicular như elementary Euclidean spatial relations trong một stated reference frame trước khi dùng slope/vector criteria.

external_curriculum_mappings.phase: Geometria spatial description and line relations

misconceptions_or_representation_notes: Horizontal/vertical depend on the chosen frame; parallel/perpendicular are Euclidean line relations.
Perpendicular means a right-angle intersection, not merely lines that look steeply different.
